_comment: Binding map for claude-mcp-metrics-analyst from ai-orchestration's generic template.
name: claude-mcp-metrics-analyst
description: Evaluate claude-mcp delegation efficiency - ROI analysis via claude_metrics, decision telemetry via claude_log_decision, defect-pattern review from claude_log_issue, and feedback-loop proposals for better task specifications. Use when evaluating Claude Code delegation efficiency.

blocks.tool_telemetry:
The `claude-mcp` server provides built-in metrics and defect logging:
  - `claude_metrics`: returns total runs, completed runs, cumulative model cost USD, and log file availability.
  - `claude_log_issue`: logs defects observed during verification into `issues.jsonl`.
  - `claude_log_decision`: logs decision branches (`delegate`, `inline`, `escalate`, `discarded`) into `decisions.jsonl`.
blocks.roi_analysis: Compare actual delegation cost against the hypothetical cost of generating the same work inline using `claude_metrics`. Detail savings and efficiency multipliers to the user.
